Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

EASY & DELICIOUS PROTEIN PREP 🔥 Episode 8️⃣   I’ve just discovered the best way to meal prep chicken for the week. Don’t forget to follow me for the next episodes in this series - I’ve got plenty more to come.  Take your chicken, marinate in incredible flavours and roast it in the oven and you are left with the juiciest and most delicious chicken for the week.  8: HOT HONEY CHICKEN Calories & macros (when divided into 5) 📊 242 calories 39g P | 9g C | 6g F This is week 6 of this new recipe series and all you need to do is:  1. Add 900g boneless, skinless chicken thighs to a large bowl or tub. You can trim off the excess fat if you want but I left it . 2. Add 2 tbsp of greek yoghurt to the chicken.  3. Add the packet of hot and honey seasoning. 4. Add 3-4 pinches salt, black pepper, chilli flakes and 15g garlic puree.   5. Mix really well and marinate for 2-6 hrs, but even better overnight. You can also make it right away if you like. The longer you leave it, the better the flavour!  6. When you're ready to eat, preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius 375F. Remove chicken from the fridge and let it come up to room temp (about 30 mins) before placing in the oven. 7. Pack the marinated chicken tightly into a loaf pan (my measurements were 8.5x4.5x2.5). Place in the oven for 50 mins. 8. Remove the chicken from the oven, gently tilt the pan into a glass jar to remove the excess juices. Pour the juices over the chicken, then repeat. Set juices aside and use for soups. Or add to a few tbsps of light mayo to make a sauce like I did.  9. Flip loaf pan onto a cutting board and cut chicken thin slices or strips. I portioned mine into 5 but you can also make it into 6.  Serve however you want & don’t forget to follow!

Another game changing meal prep recipe, all done in one sheet pan, minimal effort for maximum taste🤤🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 637 Calories | 57g Protein | 55g Carbs | 21g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Mexican Grilled Chicken - 1300g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Powder - 6 Tsp (30g) Olive Oil Creamy Street Corn Salad - 600g Canned Sweet Corn, drained - 200g Red Onion, chopped - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Paprika - 150g Red Bell Pepper, chopped - 80-100g Jalapeño, chopped - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 70-100g Low Fat Feta Cheese - 2 Tbsp Fresh Coriander/Cilantro, finely chopped - 2-3 Tsp Tajin Seasoning Coriander Lime Rice - 250g Uncooked Basmati Rice - Big Handful Coriander, finely chopped - Squeeze of Lime Juice - Pinch of Salt to taste 👨‍🍳Cooking Instructions 1. Remove chicken from pan, add sweetcorn, red onion, garlic powder and paprika. Mix in all the chicken juices then flatten evenly. Oven roast for just 15 mins until crispy. 5. Add roasted corn to a large mixing bowl, with all listed ingredients then mix well until creamy and delicious. 6.
